experiment: P3o-O adjacent-peak relation ordinal MFT-count screen
research_question: On fresh compound I/Q identities, does making the observable relation between temporally adjacent sparse delay peaks available during ordinal training improve MFT target-count estimation beyond the identical-capacity sparse-token control?

prior_boundary.P3oM: sparse local peaks improved over fixed bins but missed the three-seed low-count correlation gate; its identities, token rule and model selection are frozen.
prior_boundary.P3oN: post-hoc peak-strength/min-gap abstention degraded matched-coverage risk; its score formula, coverage and identities are frozen.
prior_boundary.mechanism_change: C1 is a training-time adjacent-event representation, not a post-hoc abstention score, threshold, calibration or a P3o-M peak-rule adjustment.

roles.development: all 33 identities per combination; read once after method freeze

front_end.shared_sparse_events: P3o-M frozen 16 strict local contrast maxima from four deterministic inverse-delay channels, restored to temporal order and zero padded
front_end.C0: append four zero relation channels to each sparse peak token
front_end.C1: append, at each valid peak, next-valid-peak normalized-magnitude difference, next contrast, sharpness difference and normalized inter-peak delay; terminal/padded relations are zero

models.C0_sparse_zero_relation: 8-channel, 16-token ordinal CNN; relation channels fixed to zero
models.C1_adjacent_peak_relation: the identical 8-channel, 16-token ordinal CNN; relation channels carry adjacent sparse-event values
models.ordinal_output: seven cumulative logits decoded to count 1 through 8

stop_rule: If any promotion gate fails, stop P3o-O. Do not tune relation channels, peak rule, model width, loss, training schedule or selection on seeds 1760M/1770M. Do not generate confirmation identities or attach an expert.
next_if_pass: Freeze all code, checkpoints and normalizers; evaluate the same oracle-positive screen on two untouched identity confirmations before considering a predicted-label-gated MFT-only attachment.
